( a ) A hydrogen production source category consists of facilities that produce hydrogen gas as a product. ( b ) This source category comprises process units that produce hydrogen by reforming, gasification, oxidation, reaction, or other transformations of feedstocks except the processes listed in paragraph (b)(1) or (2) of this section.
